title: Rhythm of AI / Three Milestones
premise: The history of AI as a rhythm game: models take the stage on the beat, and a report card closes the show.
comparison_notes: Original procedural 20-second study, 1280x720 at 24 fps; qualitative comparison to a longer upstream production. Selective history: 1997 chess match, 2016 Go match and 2022 ChatGPT introduction. FACTS.md links IBM, Google DeepMind and OpenAI primary sources. Original toy stand-ins; no logos or claims of a complete 1997–2026 chronology.
